cleavage agent: Protein samples were digested into peptides by trypsin
enrichment method: followed by anti-GFP co-immunoprecipitation and mass spectrometry
fractionation method: After running samples on SDS-PAGE gel, the gel for the same lane was cut into five slices.
instrument: analyzed on LTQ Orbitrap Velos Pro mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific)
labeling: analyzed via MaxQuant (v1.6.0.16) using label free quantification (LFQ)
